notes: A reproducible, equal-weight 3000-person joint-law scenario, not an estimate recovered from the restricted target cohort. Baseline BP only; unknown released final-reading aggregation remains unresolved. No pregnancy, HbA1c, treatment or hypertension variable is conditioned on; the law represents the task's declared retained distribution directly, including treated people in the observed-pressure mixture. Transport of demographic composition, medication mixture, BMI and BP law is unverified. SBP=DBP+positive pulse pressure, with conditional lognormal component moments chosen algebraically; all relevant moments are finite. No cohort-wide moment matching, seed selection, or forced realized coefficients. Input BMI coefficients are conditional mean settings and need not equal the requested simpler OLS projections because nonlinear age and sex-age terms are retained.

omissions_and_ambiguities: Do not transport Burkina Faso age, sex or BMI marginals directly; selected partnership and medication-free population differs markedly.
No national representativeness claim and no reconstruction of laboratory weights; draws are directly from assumed weighted analytical law.
BR study medians/IQR are not means/SD; categorical gamma contrasts are not OLS continuous BMI slopes; ABPM is not interview BP.
No HbA1c or hypertension filtering; pregnancy exclusion and admissible complete-case selection are represented as preconditions of the population law, not simulated extra exclusion steps.
Source age SD and target weight/height dictionary numeric bounds unknown. BMI lower bound is not asserted as a dictionary bound; no raw weight/height fields are generated.
Source sampling CIs are recorded but parameters are fixed in this one scenario; transport uncertainty is larger and is not quantified by increasing virtual sample size.
